bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/ (retained views, animation), springboard/ui/src/anim.rs, springboard/ui/src/scroll.rs, springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs, springboard/render/src/gfx, springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs
summary: SpriteKit is a 2D scene, node, action, physics, particle and tile-map framework for games. BifrOSt has no 2D scene graph, physics world, particle system, tile map or shader API for apps. Its retained view tree, property animation, timing curves and image decoding cover the general UI counterparts only; the Games app (2048, Minesweeper, Klondike) is hand-written and does not use an engine.

features.note: Wave 5 (theme-14, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no scene object with an update loop, no game-scene presenter; apps get a retained UI view tree and a Surface
views nest and lay out, but there is no camera node, no archived .sks scene files and no per-node z-order or transform API for 2D content
apps draw into a Surface with damage tracking (the Games app does); no node-based sprite, shape or label objects
images decode to pixels; there is no GPU-side texture object, atlas packing or dynamically updatable texture for apps

features.feature: Renderer hand-off and custom Metal pipeline
features.note: the presenter is internal; apps cannot render into their own pipeline or drive a scene update cycle

gaps: No 2D scene graph with a per-frame update cycle and a camera node for apps (SKScene, SKCameraNode).
No physics world (rigid bodies, gravity, contacts, joints, fields); only list scroll deceleration exists in springboard/ui/src/scroll.rs.
No tile map system (SKTileMapNode and its tile set and rules).
No app-facing node actions (SKAction sequence, group, repeat) or keyframe sequences (SKKeyframeSequence).
No app-facing custom shader API (SKShader, SKUniform); shaders exist only inside the system presenter.
No texture atlas or GPU texture object (SKTexture, SKTextureAtlas).
No warp geometry or inverse-kinematics constraints (SKWarpGeometry, SKReachConstraints).
The Games app (springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs) is hand-written with no engine; it is not evidence of a reusable SpriteKit-style layer.
